capabilities: Track pin and unpin actions in the background and save the pinned-note list
Reopen and re-pin saved notes automatically on startup
Update saved paths when pinned files are renamed or moved and drop deleted files
Run manual scan, restore, and clear commands from the Command Palette
Show a live list of tracked note paths in the settings panel
disambiguation: Not about pinning notes to a board or canvas; it restores pinned editor tabs across restarts.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; works on desktop and mobile. Installation from source is described by copying files into the vault.
motivation: The author built it because Obsidian does not remember pinned tabs between restarts, and Pins Save fixes that by tracking and restoring them automatically.
problem: Obsidian forgets pinned tabs on restart, so notes you keep pinned for active work are gone and unpinned after closing, crashing, or rebooting.
summary: Plugin that remembers which Markdown tabs you pinned and re-opens them as pinned tabs the next time Obsidian starts.
